zh: 化妝塗層（模擬）：${used}。${ideal ? '目前是理想色號（剛好等於你的膚色）對照。' : camoMixNote(r.mix, cols)}${camoMaskNote()}${camoCheckNote()}
en: Makeup layers (simulated): ${used}. ${ideal ? 'Currently compared against the ideal shade (exactly your skin tone).' : camoMixNote(r.mix, cols)}${camoMaskNote()}${camoCheckNote()}

zh: 淺色區塊和周圍膚色的色差：${r.deltaE.toFixed(1)}（越小越融合）；還看得出的留白約 ${Math.round(r.residPct * 100)}%。${camoCheckNote()}
en: Color difference between the lighter patch and the surrounding skin tone: ${r.deltaE.toFixed(1)} (smaller blends better); uncovered spots still visible: about ${Math.round(r.residPct * 100)}%. ${camoCheckNote()}

zh: 先擦保濕，再擦防曬，等吸收再上妝；色素少的皮膚較容易曬傷，請做好防曬。照光治療日是否上妝，請依醫師指示。
en: Apply moisturizer first, then sunscreen, and wait for them to absorb before makeup. Skin with little pigment burns more easily, so use sunscreen. On treatment days, follow your doctor's advice on whether to wear makeup.

zh: 校色：只點在淺色區塊上
en: Color correcting: dab only on the lighter patch

zh: 綠色虛線就是範圍。用指尖或小刷在淺色區塊中央薄薄點上蜜桃／橘色，不要沾到旁邊的正常皮膚。
en: The green dashed line is the area. With a fingertip or a small brush, dab a thin layer of peach/orange in the middle of the lighter patch, without getting it on the regular skin next to it.
Concealer: push outward from the center

zh: 用最接近淺色區塊「周圍」膚色的遮瑕，先點在區塊中央，再用海綿拍按、往外推進周圍皮膚，邊緣才不會有一圈。拍按不要搓。
en: Use the concealer closest to the skin tone "around" the lighter patch. Dab it in the middle of the patch first, then pat with a sponge and push outward into the surrounding skin, so there's no ring at the edge. Pat, don't rub.

zh: 第二層：只補還看得出來的地方
en: Second layer: fill in only what still shows

zh: 等第一層服貼，再薄薄補在還看得出差異的地方。兩到三層薄的，比一層厚的自然。
en: Once the first layer has settled, add a thin layer where a difference still shows. Two or three thin layers look more natural than one thick layer.
Edge blending: pat outward at the border

zh: 交界最容易看出色差，用交界色號沿邊緣一圈往外拍開，讓淺色區塊和周圍膚色接起來。
en: The border is where a color difference shows most easily. Pat the border shade outward all the way around the edge, so the lighter patch connects with the surrounding skin tone.
Foundation + powder: even out the whole face

zh: 全臉很薄一層粉底讓色調一致（淺色區塊上已經有遮瑕，少放一點）；再用粉撲把透明蜜粉按壓在淺色區塊和 T 字，不要刷。
en: Apply a very thin layer of foundation over the whole face to even out the tone (use less over the lighter patch, which already has concealer); then press translucent powder onto the lighter patch and the T-zone with a puff, don't brush.

zh: 補妝：只點還看得出來的地方
en: Touch-up: dab only where it still shows

zh: 上完底妝退後看一次，哪裡還看得出淺色，就只在那裡用同一支遮瑕點一點、邊緣拍開；少量多次，不要整片再蓋。
en: After foundation, step back and look once. Wherever a lighter spot still shows, dab a little of the same concealer only there and pat the edges out; use small amounts a few times, don't cover the whole area again.

zh: 修容在顴骨下緣、下顎線、鼻側，邊緣推開；打亮只點在顴骨上緣、鼻樑（停在鼻頭前），自然妝不打整個額頭。
en: Contour under the cheekbones, along the jawline and at the sides of the nose, pushing the edges out; highlight only on top of the cheekbones and the nose bridge (stopping before the tip of the nose), and for a natural look don't highlight the whole forehead.

zh: 先擦保濕，再擦無色防曬；淺色區塊對紫外線特別敏感。照光治療日是否上妝，請依醫師指示。
en: Apply moisturizer first, then untinted sunscreen; lighter patches are especially sensitive to UV. On treatment days, follow your doctor's advice on whether to wear makeup.

zh: 用指尖在綠色虛線範圍內薄點蜜桃／橘色校色，分小區塊，不要整臉上；不用綠色（疊上膚色粉底會發灰）。
en: With a fingertip, dab a thin layer of peach/orange for color correcting within the green dashed area, in small sections, not over the whole face; don't use green (it turns gray under skin-tone foundation).

zh: 用接近淺色區塊「周圍」膚色的遮瑕，只點在淺色區塊上，用海綿點壓、不要來回搓（用力摩擦會刺激皮膚）。
en: Use a concealer close to the skin tone "around" the lighter patch, dab only on the lighter patch, and press with a sponge without rubbing back and forth (rubbing irritates skin).

zh: 等一下讓第一層服貼，再薄薄補在還看得出差異的地方；已經融合的地方不要再疊，才不會厚重。
en: Wait a moment for the first layer to settle, then add a thin layer where a difference still shows; don't layer over areas that already blend in, so it doesn't look heavy.

zh: 交界色差最明顯，用淺一點的遮瑕點在邊緣、往外拍開淡化，讓淺色區塊和周圍膚色接起來。
en: The color difference is clearest at the border. Dab a slightly lighter concealer on the edge and pat it outward to fade it, so the lighter patch connects with the surrounding skin tone.

zh: 少量蜜粉輕壓定妝，T 字控油；最後在額頭中央、鼻樑、眼下顴骨、下巴點一點打亮，臉才不會遮完顯得暗沉、扁平。
en: Press a small amount of powder on lightly to set, controlling shine in the T-zone; finally dab a little highlight on the middle of the forehead, the nose bridge, the cheekbones under the eyes and the chin, so the face doesn't look dull and flat after being covered.

zh: 三個小問題，用來調整保養和妝容建議。
en: Three quick questions to adjust the skincare and makeup suggestions.

zh: 你比較容易敏感：選無香料、低刺激的產品，妝容已幫你減量。
en: You tend to be more sensitive: choose fragrance-free, low-irritation products; the makeup has been scaled back for you.

zh: 偶爾會不舒服：新產品先在耳後或下顎試 2–3 天。
en: Sometimes uncomfortable: patch test new products behind the ear or on the jawline for 2–3 days first.

zh: 正在照光或擦藥：這些日子要不要上妝，請依醫師指示；擦藥的地方先問醫師再上妝。
en: Treatment or active products: follow your doctor's advice on whether to wear makeup on those days; for areas with prescribed products, ask a doctor before putting on makeup.
Putting together skincare and makeup suggestions…

zh: 定案妝容暫時看不到，其他建議照常可用。
en: The final look isn't available right now; the other suggestions work as usual.

zh: 展示模式只錄了幾種組合，這個選項的變化要在正式模式（實際試妝）才看得到。
en: Demo mode only recorded a few combinations; the change for this option can only be seen in Live mode (actual try-on).
Applying foundation over the whole face…

zh: 找出淺色區塊範圍、局部遮瑕中…
en: Finding the lighter patch area and spot concealing…

en: + spot concealing on the lighter patch (simulated on your phone; the lighter patches detected make up about ${Math.round(cam.ratio * 100)}% of the face)

en: (The lighter patch area couldn't be identified in this photo, so only the full-face foundation is shown)

zh: 全臉底妝（對淺色區塊周圍的膚色）
en: Full-face foundation (for the skin tone around the lighter patch)

en: Estimated from your photo's skin tone: ${state.presets.undertones[state.toneFromSkin].label} (please check; you can go back to page 1 to change it).

en: Pick a skin tone from the photo first, so the foundation shade can be matched automatically.

en: Foundation color automatically uses the shade closest to your skin tone: ${f.brand} ${f.code} (skin tone card level ${f.level}${fit}). YouCam foundation is applied evenly over the whole face within the skin area. ${limits}

zh: 畫面上的色號是示範型錄（虛構品牌）。實際使用時，可改載入品牌提供的色號檔：系統依膚色色卡的深淺與冷暖，再加上與膚色的色差排序，列出最接近的色號。請以專櫃自然光試色為準。
en: The shades on screen come from a demo catalog (fictional brand). In real use, a brand-supplied shade file can be loaded: the app ranks shades by the skin tone card's depth and cool/warm plus the color difference to the skin, and lists the closest ones. Go by a try-on in natural light at the counter.

en: Foundation and concealer: the app lists the closest shade from each brand's shade file, ranked by the skin tone card (10 depth levels × cool/warm) and color difference; for cool/warm, use the brand's own labeling. Swatches are colors shown on a web page, so go by a try-on in natural light at the counter.

en: Try one stripe each along the jawline (where the face meets the neck), look in natural light by a window, and wait 15–30 minutes (foundation mixes with skin oil and dries slightly deeper),

zh: 再選最「看不見」的那條；兩條之間猶豫時選略淺半階的。
en: then pick the stripe that looks most "invisible"; if you cannot decide between two, pick the one about half a step lighter.

zh: 官網色票普遍比真人皮膚黃：目錄裡沒有很接近你膚色的色號，以下是明度最合、相對偏紅的候選。
en: Official website swatches are generally yellower than real skin: the catalog has no shade very close to your skin tone, so below are the candidates that best match in lightness and lean relatively red.

zh: 請在下顎線試三條、自然光下看；需要時底妝可加一點紅色調色液，淺色區塊先用紅橘色校色。
en: Please try three stripes along the jawline and look in natural light; if needed, a little red tinting liquid can be added to the foundation, and for the lighter patches, first color-correct with a red-orange.

zh: 顏色以原膚色為準：不選更白、也不選更深的色號。
en: Go by your natural skin tone: do not choose a whiter shade, and do not choose a deeper one.

zh: 若最接近的色號仍「有差」，可混兩色（彩妝師常見做法）或請專櫃以自然光試色。
en: If the closest shade is still marked "Noticeable difference", you can blend two shades (a common makeup-artist approach) or ask the counter staff to test shades in natural light.

zh: 預期妝容的打亮／修容區取色
en: Colors taken from the highlight/contour zones of the expected look

zh: 只點在泛紅、黑眼圈，同深淺或淺半階；用指腹點開，不要全臉。
en: Dab only on redness and dark circles, in the same shade level or half a step lighter; blend out with a fingertip and do not apply over the whole face.

zh: 打亮：比膚色淺一階的遮瑕，點在鼻樑、顴骨上緣，拍開。
en: Highlight: a concealer one step lighter than your skin tone, dabbed on the nose bridge and the top of the cheekbones, then patted out.

zh: 修容：深兩階、偏冷（灰褐）的粉底，刷在顴骨下方和下顎線，邊界拍開；不要用偏橘的。
en: Contour: a foundation two steps deeper and cool-leaning (gray-brown), brushed under the cheekbones and along the jawline, with the edges patted out; do not use orange-leaning ones.

zh: 型錄沒有適合的修容色（粉底不是偏橘就是太淺）：照色塊選灰褐色的修容粉，刷很淡、只在顴骨下方。
en: The catalog has no suitable contour shade (the foundations are either too orange or too light): follow the color swatch and choose a gray-brown contour powder, brushed on very lightly and only under the cheekbones.

zh: 型錄裡最接近的粉底仍比目標偏橘：刷很淡、只在顴骨下方，或選灰褐色的修容產品。
en: The closest foundation in the catalog is still more orange than the target: brush on very lightly and only under the cheekbones, or choose a gray-brown contour product.

zh: 色差不大：用一個接近周圍膚色的色號，點壓在淺色區塊上即可。
en: Small color difference: use one shade close to the surrounding skin tone and dab it over the lighter patch.

zh: 色差明顯：淺色區塊先局部校色，粉底對周圍膚色，邊緣再用淺一點的遮瑕修邊。
en: Clear color difference: first color-correct the lighter patch locally, match the foundation to the surrounding skin tone, then touch up the edges with a slightly lighter concealer.

zh: 淺色區塊顏色較淺：先用指尖只在淺色區塊上薄點蜜桃／橘色校色（深膚色用偏紅的深橘），
en: Lighter patches are paler: first, with a fingertip, dab a thin layer of peach/orange color corrector only on the lighter patches (use a reddish deep orange for deeper skin tones),

zh: 粉底才不會泛灰；淺色區塊偏粉也不用綠色，綠疊棕色粉底會發灰。
en: so the foundation does not turn gray; even if a lighter patch looks pinkish, do not use green, because green layered under brown foundation turns gray.

zh: 原膚色較深：校色選偏紅的深橘，粉底對周圍膚色。
en: Deeper natural skin tone: choose a reddish deep orange for color correcting, and match the foundation to the surrounding skin tone.

zh: 面中打亮：額頭中央、鼻樑、下巴、眼下三角，霧面或微光；T 字少量蜜粉按壓控油。
en: Center-face highlight: center of the forehead, nose bridge, chin, and the triangle under the eyes, matte or a soft glimmer; press a little loose powder on the T-zone to control oil.

zh: 選色時在下顎線試三條（淺一階、最接近、深一階），到窗邊自然光看、等 15–30 分鐘再決定：底妝和皮脂混合、變乾後會稍微變深，
en: When choosing a shade, try three stripes along the jawline (one step lighter, closest, one step deeper), look in natural light by a window, and wait 15–30 minutes before deciding: foundation mixes with skin oil and dries slightly deeper,
so if you cannot decide, pick the one about half a step lighter.

zh: 皮膚薄、容易紅；動作輕，不搓不擦，乾燥的地方上妝會浮粉。
en: Use a light touch, with no rubbing or wiping; makeup can look powdery on dry areas.

zh: 防曬 SPF50+，出門前 10–15 分鐘
en: Sunscreen SPF50+, 10–15 minutes before going out

zh: 隔離（溫和、無香料的妝前乳）
在皮膚和彩妝之間多一層保護，也讓後面的妝服貼。
en: Adds a layer of protection between the skin and the makeup, and helps the makeup that follows sit well.

zh: 眼睛也要防曬：寬簷帽、包覆式抗 UV 墨鏡
en: Protect your eyes too: a wide-brimmed hat and wraparound UV-blocking sunglasses

zh: 眼睛怕光，防曬不只擦臉。
en: Eyes can be light-sensitive too; sun protection is not just for the face.

zh: 隔離：溫和、無香料的妝前乳；要修色只修泛紅（綠色系）
en: Primer: gentle, fragrance-free; for color correcting, only correct redness (green tones)

zh: 多一層保護、讓妝服貼；不選美白提亮的紫色系，目標是調和膚色，不是更白。
en: Adds a layer of protection and helps makeup sit well; do not choose brightening purple tones, since the goal is to harmonize the skin tone, not to make it whiter.

zh: 新產品先在耳後或下顎小範圍試用
en: Try new products first on a small area behind the ear or on the jawline

zh: 選溫和、無香料，降低過敏機會。
en: Choose gentle, fragrance-free products to lower the chance of an allergic reaction.

zh: 底妝（想要時）：顏色接近原本膚色，面中最多往外推薄，T 字平刷、眼周最薄
en: Foundation (if you want it): a shade close to your natural skin tone, most on the center of the face and thinned outward, flat strokes on the T-zone, thinnest around the eyes

zh: 照配色卡的底妝色號，往外推到脖子一致；T 字少量蜜粉按壓。保留特色的妝可以不上底妝，隔離一樣要上。
en: Follow the foundation shade on the color card and blend out to the neck so it looks consistent; press on a little loose powder on the T-zone. A look that keeps your natural character can skip foundation, but still apply primer.

zh: 面中打亮（想要時）：額頭中央、鼻樑、下巴、眼下三角，霧面或微光
en: Center-face highlight (if you want it): center of the forehead, nose bridge, chin, and the triangle under the eyes, matte or a soft glimmer

zh: 膚色很淺的人常用粉色系、珠光打亮；量少一點、輕拍。
en: People with very light skin often use pink-toned, pearlescent highlighter; use a small amount and pat it on lightly.

zh: 上妝：眉、睫毛、腮紅、唇，少量多次
en: Apply makeup: brows, lashes, blush, lips, a little at a time, building up in layers

zh: 照配色卡的色號；保留原樣也可以。
en: Follow the shades on the color card; keeping things as they are is also fine.

zh: 卸妝：溫和卸妝，指尖輕打圈、紙巾輕壓
en: Makeup removal: remove gently, with fingertips in light circles and tissue pressed lightly

zh: 溫和清潔、保濕，不搓不刷
en: Gentle cleansing and moisturizing, no rubbing or brushing

zh: 摩擦、抓、用力刷都會刺激皮膚。
en: Rubbing, scratching and brushing hard irritate skin.
Sunscreen SPF50+, applied over a wide area

zh: 色素少的皮膚較容易曬傷，請做好防曬；周圍皮膚不曬黑，色差也比較小。
en: Skin with little pigment burns more easily, so use sunscreen; if the surrounding skin does not tan, the color difference is also smaller.

zh: 避開可能刺激皮膚的成分
en: Avoid ingredients that may irritate skin

zh: 染髮劑（PPD）、香水體香劑（PTBP）、部分唇眼彩染料、美白產品都可能刺激皮膚；若出現新的或擴大的淺色區塊，請看皮膚科醫師。
en: Hair dye (PPD), perfume and deodorant (PTBP), some lip and eye color dyes and whitening products can irritate skin; if you notice new or spreading lighter patches, see a dermatologist.

zh: 是否上妝、塗什麼，請依醫師或治療單位的指示；沒有特別指示時，一般保濕可以。
en: Whether to wear makeup, and what to apply, is up to your doctor or treatment provider; without other instructions, regular moisturizer is fine.

zh: 局部校色：只在淺色區塊上薄點蜜桃／橘色（不用綠色）
en: Spot color correcting: dab peach/orange only on the lighter patches (no green)

zh: 淺色區塊顏色較淺，先校色粉底才不會泛灰；不要整臉上。
en: Lighter patches are paler, so do color correcting first so the foundation does not turn gray; do not apply it over the whole face.

zh: 底妝：對淺色區塊周圍的膚色選色，面中最多、往外推薄；T 字平刷、眼周最薄；海綿點壓
en: Foundation: choose a shade to match the skin tone around the lighter patches, most on the center of the face and thinned outward; flat strokes on the T-zone, thinnest around the eyes; dab with a sponge

zh: 照配色卡的底妝色號；往外推到脖子一致。T 字少量蜜粉按壓控油。不想上可以跳過。
en: Follow the foundation shade on the color card; blend out to the neck so it looks consistent. Press a little loose powder on the T-zone to control oil. You can skip it if you prefer.

zh: 面中打亮：額頭中央、鼻樑、下巴、眼下三角，選霧面或微光
en: Center-face highlight: center of the forehead, nose bridge, chin, and the triangle under the eyes, in matte or a soft glimmer

zh: 讓臉中間亮一點、更立體；珠光太多會讓紋理和淺色區塊更明顯。
en: Makes the middle of the face a little brighter and more dimensional; too much shimmer makes skin texture and the lighter patches more noticeable.

zh: 遮瑕用點壓，不推不擦；邊緣用淺一點的修邊
en: Dab concealer on; do not push or wipe it; use a slightly lighter shade for the edges

zh: 照配色卡的遮瑕打底色、修邊色；不想遮也完全可以。
en: Follow the concealer base color and edge-touch-up color on the color card; not covering at all is also completely fine.

zh: 卸妝：溫和卸妝，紙巾輕壓
en: Makeup removal: remove gently, pressing lightly with tissue

zh: 照你原本的眉色補稀疏處
en: Fill in sparse spots using your natural brow color

zh: 照你原本的眉色深一階，加強立體感
en: One step deeper than your natural brow color, to add dimension

zh: 眉毛很淡：用原眉色的色調加深一點，讓眉毛看得見
en: Brows are very light: use the tone of your natural brow color, slightly deeper, so the brows are visible

zh: 眉毛很淡：用原眉色的色調加深，加強立體感；淺膚色不會深到太兇
en: Brows are very light: use the tone of your natural brow color, deeper, to add dimension; on light skin it will not look too harsh

zh: 你的回答顯示皮膚偏敏感，上妝前先看這幾點
en: Your answers point to sensitive skin; please look at these points before applying makeup

zh: 皮膚薄、容易紅，手指一壓就可能留紅印
en: Pat, don't rub: your skin may show pressure marks easily

zh: 上妝用輕拍，不要來回推。
en: Apply makeup by patting lightly, not pushing back and forth.

zh: 新產品先在耳後或下顎小範圍試，選溫和、無香料
en: Try new products first on a small area behind the ear or on the jawline, and choose gentle, fragrance-free ones
Do not buy a large size at first.
Have a dermatologist check your skin regularly
Do not rub, scratch, or brush hard

zh: 留意可能刺激皮膚的成分
en: Watch for ingredients that may irritate skin

zh: 新產品先小範圍試，不要急著買大罐
en: Try new products on a small area first; do not rush to buy a large size
Stop using a product if you notice irritation or an allergic reaction.

zh: 照光治療日是否上妝，請依醫師指示；不確定是什麼、或淺色區塊範圍變大，請皮膚科確認
en: On treatment days, follow your doctor's advice on whether to wear makeup; if you are not sure what it is, or the lighter patches are getting larger, please have a dermatologist check

zh: 要取兩個顏色：原本膚色、淺色區塊各一點
en: Two colors are needed: one dot on your natural skin tone and one on the lighter patch

zh: 要先取膚色：點一下臉頰或下顎
en: Pick your skin tone first: tap a spot on the cheek or jawline

zh: 冷暖是照片推估，請本人確認；色號以專櫃自然光試色為準。
en: Cool/warm is estimated from the photo, so please confirm it yourself; the shade is best judged by trying it at a beauty counter in natural light.

zh: 膚色很淺：修容只用極淡灰階，避免髒感
en: Very light skin tone: use only a very light gray for contour, to avoid a muddy look

zh: 膚色很淺：腮紅用淡的，避免大面積色塊
en: Very light skin tone: use a light blush, and avoid large patches of color

zh: 眉色很淺：不用深灰褐，照原眉色補或用冷燕麥灰
en: Very light brows: do not use a deep gray-brown; fill in with your natural brow color or use a cool oat gray

zh: 睫毛很淺：用香檳淡金，避開粗重深色
en: Very light lashes: use champagne light gold, and avoid heavy dark colors

zh: 粉冷調淺膚色：唇色用冷調櫻桃，避開橘黃
en: Light skin tone with a pink cool undertone: use a cool cherry lip color, and avoid orange-yellow

zh: 粉冷調淺膚色：腮紅避開暖杏
en: Light skin tone with a pink cool undertone: avoid warm apricot blush

zh: 暖象牙淺膚色：腮紅用暖杏
en: Light skin tone with a warm ivory undertone: use warm apricot blush

zh: 暖象牙淺膚色：眉色用淺金棕
en: Light skin tone with a warm ivory undertone: use light golden brown for the brows

zh: 中性中等膚色：眉色用灰褐，色調穩定
en: Neutral medium skin tone: use gray-brown for the brows, a steady tone

zh: 中性中等膚色：睫毛以棕色為準
en: Neutral medium skin tone: go with brown for the lashes

zh: 深膚色：修容要明顯一點，太淺會顯得灰白
en: Deep skin tone: make the contour a bit stronger; too light looks grayish-white

zh: 深膚色：精緻款用霧面深紅做對比
en: Deep skin tone: for the Polished look, use a matte deep red for contrast
Warm skin tone: use warm apricot blush

zh: 容易敏感：底妝降為自然，避免厚重
en: Sensitive skin: foundation is lowered to Natural to avoid a heavy feel

zh: 容易敏感：不上修容，減少來回刷
en: Sensitive skin: no contour, to reduce back-and-forth brushing

zh: 容易敏感：打亮只留鼻樑微光
en: Sensitive skin: highlight only a soft glow on the nose bridge

zh: 容易敏感：腮紅只點一點血色
en: Sensitive skin: blush with just a touch of natural color

zh: 容易敏感：睫毛用淡棕灰，卸妝負擔小
en: Sensitive skin: use light brown-gray lashes, which are easier on the skin when removing makeup
Sensitive skin: fill in the brows only a little

zh: 容易敏感：霧面唇容易乾，改水光自然色
en: Sensitive skin: matte lips dry out easily, so switch to a dewy natural color

zh: 眉毛本來就看得見：照原眉色補，不換成較淺的顏色
en: Your brows are already visible: fill in with your natural brow color and do not switch to a lighter color

zh: 眉毛顏色很淡：自動試妝抓不準眉毛位置，眉毛保留原樣
en: Brows are very light: the automatic try-on cannot pinpoint the brow position, so the brows are left as they are

zh: 這些妝容規則參考化妝師常見做法與 AI 建議整理，尚未經專業審核；以你自己舒適為準。
en: These makeup rules are based on common makeup-artist practice and AI suggestions, and have not been professionally reviewed; your own comfort comes first.

zh: 試底妝要先有對應的底妝色號（先取膚色）
en: To try on foundation, a matching foundation shade is needed first (pick your skin tone first)

zh: 「照原眉色」要先在照片上點眉毛和臉頰取色
en: To use "natural brow color", first tap the brow and the cheek on the photo to pick colors

zh: 深色紅唇比較搶眼，可以試試眉毛「灰褐深一階」和棕色睫毛來平衡。
en: A deep red lip is eye-catching; you can try brows "gray-brown one step deeper" and brown lashes to balance it.

zh: 這條產品線沒有同深淺的色號：一淺一深各取一半混合。
en: This product line has no shade at the same depth: take one lighter and one deeper and mix them half and half.

zh: 臉要完整出現在畫面裡
en: Your whole face needs to be in the frame
Face is too small: hold the phone a little closer

zh: 臉超出畫面：往中間移一點
en: Face is out of the frame: move a little toward the center

zh: 臉太斜：手機舉到眼睛高度、正對鏡頭
en: Face is tilted too much: hold the phone at eye level, facing the camera straight on

zh: 照片解析度不夠：改用前鏡頭最高畫質
en: The photo resolution is not high enough: use the front camera at its highest quality

zh: 伺服器找不到 API key
en: The server cannot find the API key

zh: 試妝服務太久沒回應，請再試一次
en: The try-on service took too long to respond, please try again

zh: 試妝服務暫時連不上，稍後再試
en: The try-on service is temporarily unreachable, please try again later

zh: 這張沒辦法試妝，換個角度或光線再拍一次
en: This photo cannot be tried on; take another one from a different angle or in different lighting

zh: 試妝結果是空的，請再試一次
en: The try-on result is empty, please try again

zh: 展示模式：這張照片沒有錄好的五官結果。
en: Demo mode: this photo has no recorded facial-feature result.

zh: 五官分析太久沒回應，請再試一次
en: The facial-feature analysis took too long to respond, please try again

zh: 五官分析暫時連不上，稍後再試
en: The facial-feature analysis is temporarily unreachable, please try again later

zh: 這張沒辦法分析五官，換個正面、光線均勻的照片再試
en: This photo cannot be analyzed for facial features; try a front-facing photo with even lighting

zh: 入口只有膚色很淺、膚色深淺不一兩種
en: Only two entry paths exist: very light skin tone and uneven skin tone

zh: 這個入口目前沒有這個選項的定案妝容
en: This entry does not have a finalized look for this option yet
The finalized look is not available right now

zh: 官方這一步：YouCam 試妝錄好的結果（展示模式重播，不扣點）
en: Official step: the recorded YouCam try-on result (Demo mode replay, no credits deducted)

zh: 官方這一步尚未錄製；展示模式不呼叫 YouCam，以下顯示本地結果
en: The official step has not been recorded yet; Demo mode does not call YouCam, so the local result is shown below

where: app/server.py:762 app/server.py:772 app/server.py:775 app/server.py:762 app/server.py:772 app/server.py:775

en: Does not connect to YouCam, no credits deducted

zh: 本次啟動最多呼叫幾次真 API
en: Maximum number of real API calls per launch

zh: 跨次啟動的點數總預算（帳本 runs/budget_ledger.json）
en: Total credit budget across launches (ledger runs/budget_ledger.json)

zh: demo＝只顯示虛構示範型錄（錄影片、截圖用，畫面不出現品牌名稱）
en: demo = show only the fictional demo catalog (for recording videos and screenshots; no brand names appear on screen)

zh: 臉型偏圓：腮紅從蘋果肌斜斜往太陽穴刷（目前試妝就是斜刷）。
en: Rounder face shape: sweep blush diagonally from the apples of the cheeks toward the temples (the current try-on already sweeps diagonally).

zh: 臉型偏方：腮紅斜刷、往太陽穴暈開，讓線條柔和（目前試妝就是斜刷）。
en: Squarer face shape: sweep blush diagonally and blend it toward the temples to soften the lines (the current try-on already sweeps diagonally).

zh: 臉型偏長：腮紅橫向、停在蘋果肌，不要往上拉太長。
en: Longer face shape: blush goes sideways and stops at the apples of the cheeks; do not pull it up too far.

zh: 臉型橢圓：腮紅位置照喜好，蘋果肌或斜刷都適合。
en: Oval face shape: place the blush as you like; the apples of the cheeks or a diagonal sweep both suit.

zh: 臉型上寬下窄：腮紅放在顴骨下緣、往耳朵方向，不要太靠近鼻子。
en: Wider top and narrower bottom face shape: place blush along the lower edge of the cheekbones toward the ears, not too close to the nose.

zh: 顴骨較寬：腮紅放在顴骨中央往外輕拍。
en: Wider cheekbones: place blush at the center of the cheekbones and pat it outward lightly.

zh: 下顎較寬：腮紅稍微往上、靠近顴骨高處。
en: Wider jaw: place blush slightly higher, near the high point of the cheekbones.

zh: 顴骨較高：腮紅刷在顴骨上方往外。
en: Higher cheekbones: brush blush above the cheekbones, sweeping outward.

zh: 顴骨較低：腮紅放在蘋果肌稍高的位置。
en: Lower cheekbones: place blush a little higher on the apples of the cheeks.

zh: 顴骨較平：腮紅放在蘋果肌稍高的位置，輕拍就好。
en: Flatter cheekbones: place blush a little higher on the apples of the cheeks, and just pat lightly.

zh: 臉頰圓潤：腮紅輕拍在蘋果肌。
en: Fuller cheeks: pat blush lightly onto the apples of the cheeks.

zh: 杏仁眼：睫毛用自然款就很好看。
en: Almond eyes: a natural lash style already looks lovely.

zh: 圓眼：睫毛刷在眼尾多一點，眼型會拉長一點。
en: Round eyes: brush the lashes a bit more at the outer corners to make the eye shape look a little longer.

zh: 細長眼：睫毛從根部往上刷，讓眼睛看起來比較開。
en: Narrow, elongated eyes: brush the lashes upward from the roots so the eyes look more open.

zh: 唇形較薄：水光、淺色的唇看起來比較豐潤。
en: Thinner lips: dewy, light-colored lips look fuller.

zh: 唇形較窄：水光、淺色的唇看起來比較豐潤。
en: Narrower lips: dewy, light-colored lips look fuller.

zh: 唇形豐潤：潤色護唇或霧面都適合，顏色可以淡一點。
en: Full lips: a tinted lip balm or a matte finish both suit, and the color can be softer.

zh: 下唇較厚：上唇中央多擦一點點，上下比較平衡。
en: Fuller lower lip: apply just a little more at the center of the upper lip to balance top and bottom.

zh: 上唇較厚：下唇中央多擦一點點，上下比較平衡。
en: Fuller upper lip: apply just a little more at the center of the lower lip to balance top and bottom.

zh: 眉毛較稀：照原眉色從「補一點」開始，順著毛流畫短線。
en: Sparser brows: start with "fill in a little" using your natural brow color, drawing short strokes along the hair direction.

zh: 眉毛本身濃：只要順毛、照原眉色補一點，不需要加深。
en: Naturally thick brows: just brush with the hair direction and fill in a little with your natural brow color; no need to deepen them.

zh: 眉尾比較稀：只補眉尾就好，眉形不用改。
en: Sparser at the brow tails: fill in only the tails; there is no need to change the brow shape.

zh: 五官沒有特別需要調整的地方，照喜歡的妝感就好。
en: No facial feature needs special adjustment; just go with the makeup look you like.

zh: 依五官的一般美妝原則；只是建議，保留原樣也很好。
en: Based on general makeup principles for facial features; these are only suggestions, and leaving things as they are is also great.
No face or lighter patch found

zh: 找不到清楚的臉：請換一張正面、整張臉入鏡的照片。
en: No clear face found: please use a front-facing photo with your whole face in the frame.

zh: 臉的位置抓得不太穩，結果可能有點偏；可以換個角度再拍一張，或直接繼續。
en: The face position isn't very steady, so the result may be slightly off; you can retake from another angle, or just continue.
The face size is just right.

zh: 再靠近一點，讓臉占滿畫面多一些；我們也會自動幫你裁到剛好。
en: Move a little closer so your face fills more of the frame; we'll also crop it to fit automatically.

zh: 臉有點太小了：手機拿近一點再拍。
en: Your face is a bit small: hold the phone closer and retake.

zh: 臉有點側了：手機舉到眼睛高度、正對鏡頭再拍一張。
en: Your face is turned a bit: hold the phone at eye level, face the camera, and take another photo.

zh: 臉稍微有點側：可以把手機舉到眼睛高度、正對鏡頭。
en: Your face is turned slightly: you can hold the phone at eye level and face the camera.
Your face is facing the camera.
